process_scope: Collector and all live descendant processes; profiler RAM recorded separately
ram_metric: Sampled sum of process RSS/working set; shared pages can be counted more than once
execution: Sequential, headless, same five TRAIN cases and original horizons; no policy changes
projection_method: Use actual TRAIN geometry counts per tier and mean measured per-case cost within tier; separate full-horizon scenario
projection_limit: Four sampled families out of twelve; estimates are planning scenarios, not confidence bounds or guaranteed runtime
